children.value: > Fact From Story: The Internet as we experience it represents a central obstacle to climate action, through several mechanisms.

> > Fact From Story: There’s general political polarization, which inhibits the coalitions we need to build to realize clean energy, as well as creates paralyzing infighting within the climate movement about strategies, which the platforms benefit from.
> > > Fact From Story: There’s the constant distraction from the climate crisis, in the form of the churning scandals of the day, in an attention economy where all topics compete for mental energy.
> > > Fact From Story: There’s networked opposition to the infrastructure we need for the energy transition.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Political polarization, opposition to infrastructure, and constant distraction are all mechanisms that create obstacles.
> > Fact From Story: Promotion of false information about climate change is one mechanism.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Spreading false information and political polarization are mechanisms that can create obstacles.
